title: Browse, where a newcomer finds the neighbourhood

criteria.text: Browse is its own surface at `/explore`, own tab; not merged with Home
criteria.note: Nav tab Explore, `/` redirects to `/explore` [V `page.tsx`, `BottomNav.tsx`] Checked: unmarked: `BottomNav.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Pages and posts together, complete, nothing withheld that the reader may see
criteria.note: One `browse_feed` call returns both kinds [V]; capped at `BROWSE_LIMIT = 100`, no paging seen, so a metro over 100 rows may hold some back [A]. Check #589 Checked: no (nothing asserts completeness).

criteria.text: Signed in, also own announcements and things coming up; signed out, absent
criteria.note: `FollowingRow` plus `HappeningRows`; signed out gets withheld cards only (#204, F091, F093) [V `load.ts`] Checked: unmarked: `load.test.ts`, `FollowingRow.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Signed-in half withheld server-side, never rendered and hidden
criteria.note: Second `getBrowseFeed` call only when signed in; SQL predicate on `p_following`; empty follow set still calls [V `load.ts`, build log] Checked: unmarked: `load.test.ts`, `load-withheld.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Order is locality and recency; never payment, size, follower count or what keeps you scrolling
criteria.note: `browse_feed` orders by locality and recency; `session-shuffle.ts` shuffles only inside recency bands [V]. Nothing guards the never-part. Guard #590

criteria.text: Curated lenses (today, local food, household, art, free); no kind picker; search separate
criteria.note: Built half: "What's happening… today / this week / this weekend" rows (F091); lens parameters exist in `getBrowseFeed` [V]. Missing: local food / household / art lens, newcomers lens ("newly opened here"); free lens blocked on the scenario's open question (no price substrate; recommend tag). #57 proposes chips, which this criterion rules out. Issue #587; guard for "no kind picker" in #590

criteria.text: List and map by width; Map pill under 1024; side by side from 1024; owner-panel switch at 1280-1439; signed out is list only
criteria.note: #279 and #496 (signed-out list only, Map pill opens sign-up) on main [V build logs]. The owner-panel mode sits behind a prop nothing sets (open question #278). "Nothing inserted between rows" unguarded, #590 Checked: partial marker only (`BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx:99`); check #589.

criteria.text: Scoped to the active metro; a member outside every seeded metro chooses, none is picked for them
criteria.note: Built half: results scoped to the metro; picker lists every seeded metro; pill says "Choose your area" when unchosen [V]. Missing: `resolveFeedMetro` falls back to Sacramento, so a metro is picked for them (its own comment: "known limitation of a one-metro launch"). Issue #588 (needs-pm) Checked: no (`scope.test.ts` asserts the fallback).

criteria.text: Metro switcher moves a signed-in member's results too
criteria.note: Requested slug beats the member's stored metro; the pick saves as their default (#479) [V `scope.ts`, `actions.test.ts`] Checked: unmarked: `actions.test.ts`, `scope.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Past-dated posts drop out on their own
criteria.note: `browse_feed` drops `starts_at < now()`, undated never drop [V migration] Checked: unmarked: `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts:671`.

criteria.text: Each result carries the name its people are known by; a concealing brand label fails
criteria.note: Page's name on both Pages and posts [V `BrowseResultCard.tsx`, `card.ts`]. Concealment is a Page-content question, not checked here [A] Checked: unmarked: `BrowseResultCard.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Shared link reopens same metro and search; back restores scroll
criteria.note: `?metro=`, `?q=`, `?category=` round-trip (`query.ts`); scroll restored once per mount under the literal key `'explore'`, so a metro switch is not re-keyed. Open #54 covers the key and the re-arm Checked: unmarked: `query.test.ts`, `useScrollRestoration.test.ts`.
